Hi Sanjay — Jonas here (inference infra). Quoting your questions below and responding inline: 

> Can you confirm where the KMS key material for KVCache lives (region + whether keys are in an HSM-backed vault or software KMS)?

KVCache keys are provisioned in a regional HSM-backed vault (AWS CloudHSM for us-east-1, Azure Key Vault HSM for eu-west-1). Primary key material used for long-term signing is resident in the region where the cache node is pinned. For cross-region failover we use an ephemeral wrapping key with limited lifetime and explicit replication events (not continuous replication of unwrapped key material).

> For ephemeral keys used during inference (prefix caching / KV store), do you rotate per-request or per-session? Any TTL guidance helps us evaluate exposure windows.

Ephemeral session keys: rotated per-session by default; TTL is configurable but set to 15 minutes for production inference workloads. We also support shorter TTLs (down to 30s) for high-security tenants. Ephemeral keys are derived from the regional HSM master using a one-way KDF and are never exported in plaintext.

> We may ask for a short log extract or signing certificate that proves the public key residency — would you be able to include a signed artifact for KVCache?

Yes — we can provide a signed artifact (PDF) that includes the key fingerprint and a notarized timestamp from our signing HSM. Attaching the first draft of that artifact here. If you need notarization via your CA, let us know and we can route through the DocuSign envelope and provide the certificate chain.

Attachments included: kvcache_kms_proof.pdf (contains key fingerprints, HSM residency table, and TTL parameters). I also added the Drive link to the proof bundle and the DocuSign envelope for the escrow addendum.

If this satisfies your audit, we can mark the KVCache attestation complete; otherwise, we can schedule a 30-minute call to walk through the artifacts and live logs.
